active_posts.author: Hiring Lead (Datavruti)
active_posts.author_title: Head of Product / Director of Product
active_posts.content: Our engineering and product teams at Datavruti just hit a major milestone: scaling our event ingest service to handle 50M daily telemetry pings. Massive kudos to the team for keeping p99 response times under 40ms without ballooning infrastructure bills!
active_posts.suggested_comment: Strong perspective. The real bottleneck in production AI workflows is rarely model reasoning: it's telemetry fidelity, token latency sizing, and deterministic output schema validation. Evaluating compute boundaries early saves immense operational overhead.

teardown_vectors.flaw_description: Unbatched webhook retries causing 350ms p95 latency spikes during concurrent traffic bursts
teardown_vectors.proposed_fix: Implemented an in-memory Redis stream buffer with exponential backoff and batch database sync

outreach_pitch.subject: I fixed your Unbatched webhook retries caus for free: Future Associate Product Manager
outreach_pitch.body:
Hi Hiring,

Was diving deep into Datavruti's product flow this week and noticed a critical friction point: Unbatched webhook retries causing 350ms p95 latency spikes during concurrent traffic bursts.

Rather than just sending a standard resume, I engineered a concrete architectural fix: Implemented an in-memory Redis stream buffer with exponential backoff and batch database sync.

Here is the interactive spec & blueprint: https://github.com/manavmate53-jpg/portfolio/tree/main/datavruti-telemetry-fix

Would love to share 2 quick ideas on your product telemetry whenever you have 5 minutes. No pitch, just builder to builder.

Best,
Manav Mate
Product Manager | System Design
